v2-dev-01.label_notes: Price adjacent to Qty is provisionally labeled per-unit under the existing fixture convention; confirm with language/domain review. Identity and street replaced.

v2-dev-02.label_notes: Compact price follows the existing fixture per-unit convention. Payment claim is excluded, including from note.

v2-dev-03.label_notes: Unlabeled lines retain customer/address and both items. Compact prices are provisionally per-unit.

v2-dev-04.label_notes: Join adjacent variant fields to their own product; do not invent an address.

v2-dev-05.label_notes: Three independent items; compact prices use the provisional per-unit convention.

v2-dev-06.label_notes: Township is separately stated. Address need not repeat it; prices follow the compact fixture convention.

v2-dev-07.label_notes: Preserve Black/XL wording; payment chatter is excluded.

v2-dev-08.label_notes: Same template family as case 01; cannot be treated as independent held-out data.

v2-dev-09.label_notes: Preserve hyphenated product wording. Source identity, phone and building replaced.

v2-dev-10.label_notes: Adapted seller vocabulary. Explicit unit price replaces conversational price question. Township alone is not a complete address. Fee question does not specify a fee.

v2-dev-11.label_notes: Quantity is three saleable packs, not twelve pieces. Four-piece content stays in description.

v2-dev-12.label_notes: Two distinct variants; no explicit per-unit price. Do not divide bundle total. Separately payable delivery is unknown, not zero.

v2-dev-13.label_notes: Explicit correction wins. Weight is not quantity or price. Free delivery means numeric zero.

v2-dev-14.label_notes: One fee for the order. Deliver-together instruction is a note; payment claim is excluded. Single-copy price applies to the second item.

v2-dev-15.label_notes: Use only the explicitly corrected address. Fee inquiry is not a price or fulfillment note.

v2-dev-16.label_notes: Explicit phone replacement retains the leading zero. Phone strings are synthetic placeholders, never copied customer contacts.

v2-dev-17.label_notes: Same development family as case 16; latest explicit correction replaces old ASCII phone.

v2-dev-18.label_notes: Two numbers without recipient labels or correction cannot establish a preferred phone.

v2-dev-19.label_notes: No quantity is stated; do not apply the parser's default of one as an extracted fact.

v2-dev-20.label_notes: Explicit zero unit price is populated data, not missing.

v2-dev-21.label_notes: Total alone never becomes a unit price even when division is exact.

v2-dev-22.label_notes: Explicit call-before-arrival instruction is retained, with original-script evidence for the normalized phone.

v2-dev-23.label_notes: Instruction text is untrusted content, not a real phone, fee, note or payment field.

v2-dev-24.label_notes: Keep all address lines and separately record the explicitly named township.

address.pattern: Address corrections and delivery conditions; adapted.

authored.description: New regression cases informed by v1 failure categories; not independent held-out evidence.

books.pattern: Delivery charged per order and payment on arrival; adapted.

bundle.pattern: Individual and bundle pricing; adapted, not a customer message.

food.pattern: Pack contents, package weights and per-pack prices; adapted, not a customer message.

meo.pattern: Product codes, colour and size wording; adapted, not a customer message.

user-samples.description: Nine examples supplied in this conversation; names, phones and street addresses replaced. Not verified real customer chats.
